changelog: The follow-up panel on a record (sales lead page, mentor mentee page, admin candidate page) shows a saved follow-up as a read-only note — the day with its weekday, red when overdue and amber on the day, and the next step as text — with an Edit button that opens the form (Save, Cancel, Clear). With nothing saved it offers "Add follow-up". Presentation only; the API and rules are unchanged (#3647).

en: A saved follow-up now reads as a note — the day (with its weekday) and the next step — and opens for editing only when you press Edit.
tr: Kayıtlı bir takip artık bir not gibi okunuyor: gün (haftanın günüyle) ve sonraki adım. Düzenleme formu yalnızca Düzenle'ye basınca açılıyor.
de: Eine gespeicherte Wiedervorlage liest sich jetzt wie eine Notiz – der Tag (mit Wochentag) und der nächste Schritt – und öffnet sich erst mit „Bearbeiten“ zum Ändern.
